tradition.en: Sharing a meal is an important family tradition.
tradition.zh: 一起吃饭是一项重要的家庭传统。

tradition.en: The village keeps its tradition of making wooden toys.
tradition.zh: 这个村子保留着制作木玩具的传统。

tradition.en: It is a local tradition to welcome guests with tea.
tradition.zh: 用茶招待客人是当地的习俗。

bank.en: There is a bank beside the station.
We found a quiet place on the river bank.
bank.zh: 我们在河岸上找到了一处安静的地方。

bank.en: The bank is closed on Sundays.
bank.zh: 这家银行星期日不营业。

light.en: Morning light came through the small window.
light.zh: 晨光透过小窗照了进来。

light.en: The empty basket is light enough for me to carry.
She chose a light green notebook.
light.zh: 她选了一本浅绿色的笔记本。

right.en: You chose the right answer this time.
Turn right after the small bridge.
Every child has the right to learn.
right.zh: 每个孩子都有学习的权利。

watch.en: We watch the birds from our kitchen window.
watch.zh: 我们从厨房的窗边观察鸟儿。

watch.en: My watch fell behind the sofa.
watch.zh: 我的手表掉到沙发后面了。

watch.en: Please watch the soup while I get the bowls.
watch.zh: 我去拿碗，请帮忙看着锅里的汤。

industry.en: Many people here work in the fishing industry.
industry.zh: 这里很多人在渔业工作。

industry.en: Tourism is an important industry in this town.
industry.zh: 旅游业是这个小镇的重要产业。

industry.en: New machines have changed the car industry.
industry.zh: 新机器改变了汽车行业。

kid.en: The kids are playing near the pond.
kid.zh: 孩子们正在池塘边玩耍。

kid.en: I am only kidding; your drawing looks great.
kid.zh: 我只是在开玩笑，你的画很好看。

kid.en: When I was a kid, I wanted to build a boat.

stock.en: The shop has no milk in stock today.
stock.zh: 这家店今天没有牛奶存货。

stock.en: She bought stock in a small company.
stock.zh: 她买了一家小公司的股票。

stock.en: We keep a small stock of tools in the shed.
stock.zh: 我们在棚子里备着少量工具。

coach.en: Our coach showed us how to pass the ball.
We took a coach to the next town.
coach.zh: 我们坐长途客车去了邻镇。

coach.en: She wants to coach the school team.

facility.en: The town needs a new sports facility.
facility.zh: 这个小镇需要一处新的体育设施。

facility.en: The hotel has facilities for young children.
facility.zh: 这家酒店有供幼儿使用的设施。

facility.en: We visited a facility that cleans drinking water.
facility.zh: 我们参观了一处净化饮用水的设施。

present.en: I wrapped a small present for my sister.
present.zh: 我给妹妹包好了一份小礼物。

present.en: All six students are present today.
present.zh: 今天六名学生都到齐了。

present.en: We are staying here at present.

fine.en: I feel fine after a good night of sleep.
fine.zh: 睡了一晚好觉后，我感觉很好。

fine.en: We had fine weather for our boat trip.
fine.zh: 我们乘船出游时天气晴朗。

fine.en: He had to pay a fine for parking there.
fine.zh: 他在那里停车，必须交罚款。

book.en: I left my book on the kitchen table.
book.zh: 我把书忘在厨房桌上了。

book.en: You can book a room on the hotel website.
book.zh: 你可以在酒店网站上预订房间。

book.en: This book explains how to grow vegetables.
book.zh: 这本书介绍如何种蔬菜。

river.en: The river runs through the village.
We crossed the river in a small boat.
The river is deeper after the rain.

match.en: The football match starts after lunch.
match.zh: 足球比赛在午饭后开始。

match.en: He used a match to light the stove.
match.zh: 他用一根火柴点燃了炉子。

match.en: These blue curtains match the chairs.
match.zh: 这些蓝色窗帘和椅子很搭。

letter.en: I wrote a letter to my grandmother.
The first letter of my name is L.
letter.zh: 我名字的第一个字母是 L。

spring.en: A small spring holds the lid in place.
spring.zh: 一根小弹簧把盖子固定在原位。

spring.en: Clear water flows from the spring.
spring.zh: 清澈的水从泉眼里流出。

train.en: The train leaves at seven in the morning.
They train together before every competition.
train.zh: 每次比赛前他们都一起训练。

patient.en: The nurse brought the patient a glass of water.
patient.zh: 护士给病人端来了一杯水。

patient.en: Our teacher is patient with new students.
patient.zh: 我们的老师对新学生很有耐心。

kind.en: What kind of music do you like?
It was kind of you to help me carry this.
kind.zh: 你帮我搬这个，真是太好了。

break.en: Please be careful not to break the glass.
We took a short break beside the lake.
break.zh: 我们在湖边休息了一会儿。
